Commentary.Commentary: 166 to win then for Pakistan. Easy one? Tough ask for Sri Lanka to defend this with the dew. Wishing them all the best...

Pakistan were inconsistent with the ball, perhaps struggling to adjust to the dew. Hasnain was expensive but eventually ended up taking 3 wickets. Imad Wasim was the man responsible for the choke, going at 6 an over, while Amir was brilliant too.

Gunathilaka's wicket was the injection Pakistan needed as they came back nicely after that. No one batsman managed to stay for long in the middle or score that quickly. They could just cross 160, which on this surface, with the dew, looks to be 40 runs short at least.

It was a solid start from the visitors as they raced to an 84-run stand for the opening wicket. Their first 50-run opening partnership in T20Is in 2019. Gunathilaka was going bonkers, taking the attack to Pakistan but he kind of got subdued after the Powerplay. That affected the scoring slightly and eventually, he got out.
Excellent comeback from Pakistan. At one stage, it seemed like Sri Lanka could have reached 200. But some smart bowling restricted the Lankans.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for one more. SRI LANKA FINISH ON 165/5!
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
A short ball, Wanindu looks to pull but misses and is hit on the helmet. The players ask the batsman whether he is fine and thankfully, he is.
On middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Landed outside off, slammed through point for a couple.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Hasaranga looks to go over the top but is cramped for room. The ball takes the top edge and goes over mid off who is inside the circle and the ball races to the fence.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
No hat-trick. Full and outside off, Hasaranga looks to drive but misses.
Wanindu Hasaranga comes in at number 7, replacing Jayasuriya.

OUT! Catch taken by the other returning man, Ahmed Shehzad this time. A short ball, outside off, Shehan looks to go over the off side but mistimes it, as the bat turns in his hand. The ball goes high in the air and Ahmed Shahzad runs in from cover to take a simple catch. HAT-TRICK FOR HASNAIN! No one realized but he took wickets on 15.6, 18.1 and 18.2. Congratulations to the kid!
Isuru Udana walks in at number 6, replacing Shanaka.

OUT! Watch out, collision but catch taken! Oh dear... the returning men, Umar Akmal and Ahmed Shahzad collide with each other. But the catch is taken cleanly. Hasnain gets his second of the evening. He bowls one on a length and Shanaka goes for a wild swing but the ball goes into the night sky. Umar Akmal at long on goes for the catch in the meantime Ahmed Shehzad runs across to him from his left and collides with him. However, while Shehzad falls, Akmal manages to hold his balance and take the catch. Superb concentration. The Sri Lankan skipper departs.
Mohammad Hasnain is back on. 3-0-31-1 so far.
Full and outside off, driven straight back.

NOT OUT. Don't know what the keeper heard. That too in this loud din. A length ball outside off, Jayasuriya gets across to play the reverse pull but misses. No one apart from the keeper hears any noise and he wants to get it checked. Nope. Nothing on Ultra Edge. Waste of a review.
UDRS! Sarfaraz reckons that Jayasuriya is caught behind. Takes the review. Nothing on Ultra Edge.
Full and on middle, paddled to short fine leg for a quick run.
Outside off, tapped towards cover for a quick single.
Down the leg side, Dasun misses his flick and is hit on the pads. A quick leg bye taken.
Outside off, Shanaka looks to steer it to third man but misses.
Outside off, steered through point for a run. 15 from the over!

SIX! CRASH! That sounded sweet. Short and outside off, Shanaka gets on top of the bounce and pulls it over mid-wicket! Sarfaraz walks all the way, sorry, runs all the way towards his bowlers and advices him in the ear. Not shouting, it seems.
SIX! Massive! A length ball, a bit too straight, Shanaka gets under it and sends it over long on!
Outside off, edged away for a single.

Direct hit and Shanaka gone! But no direct hit and Dasun is in. Full and outside off, SJ pushes it towards cover and sets off for a quick single. Ahmed Shahzad takes aim and has a shy at the bowler's end and Shanaka was halfway in the middle, after being called for a run. But the fielder misses.
Fuller one outside off, Shanaka pushes it to mid off for a single.
Shehan Jayasuriya walks in next at number 5, replacing Bhanuka Rajapaksa. Faheem Ashraf returns as well. 2-0-16-0 so far.

OUT! LBW! Another wicket. Pakistan are closing this innings nicely. 200 looks far far far far far far farfetched from here. FIRST T20I WICKET FOR HASNAIN. A near-perfect yorker, around middle and leg, Rajapaksa misses it and also fails to take his boot out of the way. Is hit right on the right shoe and the umpire does not take long to acknowledge the LBW appeal. Ball Tracker confirms as well.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.
SIX! Nicely struck! Right off the middle. A length ball outside off, Rajapaksa backs away to the leg side and lofts it cleanly over wide long off!
Around off, tapped to the off side for a single.
A short ball, pulled uppishly towards deep square leg.
FOUR! Full and down the leg side, Rajapaksa tickles it towards fine leg and the ball races away!
In comes the skipper. Dasun Shanaka walks in at number 4, replacing Avishka.

OUT! Bull's eye and Avishka is run out! Shadab Khan, you beauty!  Superb fielding. Full and outside off, Avishka drives this towards mid off and sets off for a single. The bowler leaps to stick his hand out and parries it towards mid off. Shadab Khan comes running in from there and gets to the ball quickly. Now, the batsman has to run around the bowler, hence, he loses some time. Despite getting overbalanced, Shadab scores a direct hit at the bowler's end.
Rajapaksa skips down the track to the length ball and pushes it to long off for a single.
Fuller one on off, Rajapaksa strokes one down the ground to long on. The batsmen get a couple.
Slower one outside off, Rajapaksa gets cramped on the cut and the ball goes past the outside edge into the mitts of the keeper.
Mohammad Amir returns. 1-0-8-0 so far.

EDGED AND FOUR! Fuller outside off, Avishka throws his bat at it but ends up getting a thick outside edge. The ball flies high and wide of the man at third man. It bounces just inside the ropes and goes away for a boundary. Sri Lanka won't mind how they come as long as they keep coming.
Fuller on off, Bhanuka comes down the track and hits it hard but there is a man at long off so just a single.
Hits the deck hard on off, Fernando pulls it towards deep square leg and takes a single.

Another poor fielding. Free run this. Length delivery on off, Avishka flat-bats it wide of extra cover and calls for a quick run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. The backup is too far behind and they get another run. There was no need for the attempted direct hit there.

Good length ball on off, Rajapaksa pushes it towards backward point and calls for a quick run. Iftikhar gets to the ball quickly and has a shy at the bowler's end. It hits Bhanuka on his arm but all's well as it is not a nasty blow.
Back of a length ball on off, Avishka pulls it to deep mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Mohammad Hasnain is back on. 1-0-12-0, his figures in this game.
Rajapaksa cuts this short delivery outside off only to find the fielder at point.
Fuller one on the pads, Fernando flicks it off his pads to mid-wicket for a single.
Fernando goes to  sweep on this fuller one but fails to lay bat on ball and gets rapped on pads. No real appeal from the bowler.
Flatter one outside off, Rajapaksa pushes it to covers for a single.
FOUR! Innovative from Rajapaksa. He gets down on his knees and plays the scoop over the keeper's head for a boundary. The debutant looks to be in high confidence here. He is playing his shots.
Flatter one on middle, Fernando flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Imad Wasim returns. 3-0-17-0 so far.
Outside off, Bhanuka looks to cut but misses.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Outside off, chopped down to short third man for a single.
SIX! Clean strike. Shadab goes full and Rajapaksa slogs sweeps him over the mid-wicket fence to fetch him his first six in the T20Is. Shadab is all over the park.
Toseed up delivery outside off, Fernando plays it to point for a quick single.
Flatter one on middle, Fernando skips down the track only to play it back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a couple.
Another slider, on middle, Bhanuka looks to work it to the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads. Iftikhar appeals but this time his captain does not support him. Probably going down leg.
Outside off, the quicker one, Bhanuka pushes but misses.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. The batsmen have run through for a single.

NOT OUT. Pakistan just about escape losing a review. Full and around middle, Fernando looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. The bowler appeals and his skipper supports him. But nothing from the umpire. Referred upstairs and replays show that the ball is clipping the outer half of leg stump.
Review time! Sarfaraz is confident that Fernando is a goner. The umpire has not given it and he takes the referral. Here comes Ball Tracker. Clipping leg stump. Review safe, batsman also safe.
FOUR! Bad ball to start. Short and down the leg side, Avishka pulls it to the fine leg fence! 'AARAMSE, AARAMSE!' yells Sarfaraz. Probably Iftikhar is bowling too quick.
Flatter one and outside off, Rajapaksa defends it off the back foot to the off side.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Iftikhar Ahmed to bowl now.
Bhanuka Rajapaksa walks in at number 3, replacing Gunathilaka. One of the two Bhanukas who are debuting tonight.

OUT! LBW! That's an excellent umpiring decision. Gunathilaka departs after playing a handy knock. Shadab gets the first breakthrough. He tosses one up on middle and invites the batsman to go for the sweep. Danushka obliges and plays the sweep only to miss it and get rapped on the pads. As soon as the ball hit the pads, Khan went in appeal and the umpire raised his finger in a flash. Gunathilaka after consulting his partner goes for the review. It was a legitimate delivery pitching on middle and turning in. Ball Tracker shows it to be umpire's call, clipping the leg stump and Gunathilaka has to take a long walk back to the pavillion. End of an enterprising innings. Chance for Pakistan to make a comeback?

LBW! Shadab has taken a wicket. But Gunathilaka has taken the review too. Pitching outside leg? Nope. Or looks not. Nothing on the Ultra Edge. Clipping the leg stump, umpire's call! Review safe, Gunathilaka unsafe!
Good running between the wickets. This time Gunathilaka is successful to cut it through point and till the ball gets cleaned up in the deep by the fielder the batsmen cross for a couple.
Flatter on middle, Gunathilaka looks to go through the off side only to wear it on the pads. There is a muted appeal from the bowler but the umpire is unmoved.
Flatter one outside off, Avishka makes room to go over the off side but can only get it to covers for a single.
On middle and leg, flicked away for one.
Outside off, punched towards the off side.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Outside off, punched down to long on for a run.
On middle, flicked through the leg side for a single.
Fuller one on off, Danushka drives it to long on for a single.

DROPPED AND SIX! Shadab goes short and Gunathilaka pulls it superbly through mid-wicket. Iftikhar Ahmed stationed there, gets to the ball but loses his balance. He takes the catch but then the ball spills out of his palms and lands on the other side of the ropes, to hand Gunathilaka a six. He also reaches his 2nd T20I fifty.
Flatter on middle, Fernando works it to mid off for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Fernando defends it to point.
Flatter one on off, Fernando pushes it to covers.
Leg spinner on middle, Gunathilaka works it to mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Outside off, played straight to point.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.

Outside off, Avishka pushes it towards point and sets off for a single. The bowler himself goes after the ball and flicks it to the right side and hits the stumps without looking. Jonty Rhodes, Ricky Ponting, Herschelle Gibbs, Michael Clarke and my playstation would be happy with that. Hitting the stumps without looking.
Faheem Ashraf returns. 1-0-12-0 so far.
Down the leg side, Danushka misses his flick and is hit on the pads. 14 from the over and Sri Lanka end the Powerplay on 64/0!
FOUR! The runs continue to flow! Full and down the leg side, Gunathilaka gets down and sweeps it perfectly between short fine leg and square leg!

STUMPING MISSED! How costly will this be for Pakistan? Khan bowls a leg spinner and the ball spins past the inside edge of Gunathilaka and goes between the bat-pad gap. Ahmed fails to gather it cleanly and the ball hits his gloves and lobs in the air. But he is unable to sight the ball only to grant a life to Danushka. The fielding woes continue for the hosts.
Down the leg side, helped through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! This is short now and Gunathilaka pulls this through mid-wicket!
FOUR! Welcome into the attack! Full and down the leg side, Gunathilaka gets down and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary!
Shadab Khan into the attack.
Outside off, Avishka steers this towards third man but it goes off the edge. Sarfaraz flings himself to his right and stops it on the bounce.

A length ball outside off, coming in, slower in pace, off cutter, Gunathilaka looks to tuck it to the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads. The ball deflects to the off side and the batsmen take a leg bye. 50-RUN OPENING STAND IS UP, Sri Lanka's first in T20Is in 2019!
Outside off, pushed towards cover for a quick couple.
FOUR! Brilliant bowling but excellent batting too! A yorker outside off, but Gunathilaka gets his bat down in time and squeezes this through the vacant slip region to the third man fence!
On a length, outside leg, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Mohammad Amir to bowl now.
Length and outside off, Danushka opens the face of the bat and runs this down to third man for a single.
Danushka innovates but does not get the result as he missed his scoop on this length ball down the leg side. No wide signalled as the batsman got across.
FOUR! LOVELY! Hasnain changes his angle but there is no change in the result! Full and outside off, Gunathilaka leans and drives this through the covers!

FOUR! Excellent timing. A change in angle but no change in fortune for Hasnain as he bowls a half volley outside off and Gunathilaka drives it through covers and the ball goes to the fence like a rocket.
WIDE! Once again down the leg and umpire signals wide.

FOUR! LEG BYES! On a length and on middle, Danushka looks to go for a pull over the cow corner but the length is not ideal for the shot. Instead he wears a blow on the thigh pads and the ball runs to the third man fence in no time.
WIDE! Wayward from Hasnain. He bowls on  a length but the line is down leg. Umpire calls it a wide.
Back of a length outside off, Avishka guides it uppishly through point and takes a single.
Tossed up on middle, Avishka works it to mid-wicket and retains the strike.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.

EDGED, FOUR! No slip and Pakistan pay the price. Landed outside off, the quicker delivery, Gunathilaka looks to push but the ball skids off the deck and ekes out an outside edge. No slip present and the ball races to the third man fence.
Loopy delivery outside off, Avishka pushes it to backward point and hares for a quick single. The batsmen get the run despite a direct hit at the striker's end.
Full and straight, pushed towards mid on.
Landed around off, tapped towards point for a quick single.
On a length outside off, punched towards cover where Ahmed Shehzad fields but then slips. Clearly, dew is omnipresent. A single taken due to the misfield. 12 from the over.
Full and around off, driven back to the bowler.

FOUR! Now Gunathilaka joins the fun. Ashraf is guilty of overpitching it and bowls it in the zone of Danushka. Gunathilaka skips down the track and clobbers it past mid off as the ball races to the fence like a tracer bullet.

'The less said about the fielding effort, the better', chides Ramiz Raja on air. Full and outside off, Gunathilaka comes forward and pushes it towards mid off. It is a quick and risky single but Mohammad Hasnain charging in slips and returns a wild throw, which goes north, well wide of Sarfaraz, to third man! First sign of dew? The batsmen take the second on the overthrow.
Full and outside off, nicely driven but cannot pierce mid off. A single taken.

FOUR! Fantastic drive. Ashraf bowls one on a fuller length and offers width outside off, Fernando leans and drives it through cover-point for  first boundary of the innings. That was just superb timing.
Faheem Ashraf to bowl from the other end.
First run off the bat. On the pads, Avishka glances it towards mid-wicket and keeps the strike. 5 off the first over. A good over from Imad to start up.
Avishka starts his innings with a solid back foot defense.

WIDE! Wild delivery from Imad. He completely misses his line and length and sprays one way down the leg side. Gunathilaka leaves it alone and the ball is too wide of the diving Sarfaraz. The fielder from short fine leg does really well to pull it back with a dive before the ropes. Saves a run for his side as the batsmen come back for the third. The on-field umpire goes upstairs to confirm and replays show that the man has done well to save a run for his team.
Beaten! Floated outside off, Gunathilaka looks to drive it on the up on the off side. The ball though turns away and beats the outside edge of Danushka's bat.
Shorter around leg, Gunathilaka makes room and punches it towards cover.
Darts it on middle and leg, Gunathilaka flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Imad starts with a flatter delivery on middle and leg. It spins away just a fraction. Gunathilaka pushes it to mid off off the outer half of his bat.

Done and dusted with the national anthems and now we are all set for the action to begin. The fans in Lahore can't wait for it and neither can we. The Pakistan players are in a huddle before they take their respective positions in the field. Imad Wasim to take the ball first up for Pakistan. Danushka Gunathilaka and Avishka Fernando stride out to open the innings for Sri Lanka.

Both set of players walk out to the middle to a huge reception from the fans for their respective national anthems. First up it will be the visitor's anthem. We are not far away from the start of the game here.
Pakistan Playing XI - Ahmed Shehzad, Babar Azam, Umar Akmal, Asif Ali, Sarfaraz Ahmed (C and WK), Iftikhar Ahmed, Faheem Ashraf, Imad Wasim, Shadab Khan, Mohammad Amir, Mohammad Hasnain.

Sri Lanka Playing XI - Avishka Fernando, Danushka Gunathilaka, Shehan Jayasuriya, Bhanuka Rajapaksa (Debut), Minod Bhanuka (WK) (Debut), Dasun Shanaka (C), Isuru Udana, Lakshan Sandakan, Wanindu Hasaranga, Kasun Rajitha, Nuwan Pradeep.

TOSS - We are all set for the coin to go up for the first time in Lahore. Pakistan skipper, Sarfaraz Ahmed has the coin in hand. Up it goes and it comes down in favour of Sarfaraz. PAKISTAN OPT TO BOWL!

Done and dusted with ODIs, now we move to the shortest and quickest format of cricket in this series. It's not just a change of format, there is a change of venue as well. From Karachi the battlefield now shifts to Lahore. A few changes in the side for the hosts as Umar Akmal and Ahmed Shehzad come in. It will be interesting to see whether the duo make it into the playing XI. Skipper Sarfaraz Ahmed will hope that his side continues its good work from the ODIs and puts up another show for the home fans. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, have a lot of things to ponder upon. They were good with the bat in the final ODI but the bowlers would need the fielders to back them up in the field which was average at best in both the ODIs. Different format means different skipper for the visitors in this tour. Dasun Shanaka is all set to lead his troops here and all the Lankan fans will hope that it also brings a change in fortunes for them. They will need to be at their brilliant best if they are to silence the home fans. Will the Lions roar or will normalcy prevail? Stay tuned as the toss is not far away.
